Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all distinct molecules mentioned in the specified document. Require canonical SMILES to be available. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, then to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by document ChEMBL ID. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
